content.title: Plan webapp port configuration changes
content.description:
Plan the port standardization for the webapp. Identify every location that hardcodes or defaults a port and define the exact edits needed:

Targets:
- Dev: webapp (vite) = 3000, API = 3001
- E2E: webapp (vite) = 5000, API = 5001

Audit at minimum: server/index.ts (PORT default), frontend/vite.config.ts (apiPort + vitePort defaults), playwright.config.ts (webServer ports, baseURL, env vars, explanatory comment), package.json scripts, docs/markdown, and .agentic/expertise/** files (e.g. webapp-server-ports.expertise.md). Note any other consumers of the API port (e.g. frontend proxy, e2e fetch helpers).

Output a concrete change list as a comment. Do not make code changes in this phase.

content.content:
Port standardization audit complete. Concrete change list below — NO code changes made in this phase (planning task only).

## Target ports
- **Dev:** vite frontend = 3000, API (hono) = 3001
- **E2E/validation:** vite frontend = 5000, API (hono) = 5001

## A. Config files (the 3 the parent issue prescribes)

### A1. `packages/webapp/server/index.ts` (line 29)
- Current: `process.env.PORT || "3000"`
- New: `process.env.PORT || "3001"`
- Effect: dev API moves from 3000 → 3001. E2E already overrides via `PORT` env, so unaffected until A3.

### A2. `packages/webapp/frontend/vite.config.ts` (lines 6–7)
- `apiPort` default (line 6): `"3000"` → `"3001"` (keep parity with A1).
- `vitePort` default (line 7): currently only set when `VITE_PORT` is provided, else undefined → Vite falls back to its built-in 5173. Change so dev vite defaults to **3000** when `VITE_PORT` is unset. Concretely:
  ```ts
  const apiPort = process.env.API_PORT || "3001";
  const vitePort = process.env.VITE_PORT ? parseInt(process.env.VITE_PORT, 10) : 3000;
  ```
  The existing `...(vitePort !== undefined && { port: vitePort, strictPort: true })` then always binds 3000 in dev and 5000 in E2E (where `VITE_PORT=5000` is set in A3). `strictPort: true` should remain so a port clash fails loudly rather than silently rolling to another port.
- The proxy `/api` target already derives from `apiPort`, so it follows automatically (no separate edit).

### A3. `packages/webapp/playwright.config.ts`
- Header comment (lines 5–12): replace "dedicated ports (3001 backend, 5174 frontend)" → "(5001 backend, 5000 frontend)".
- `baseURL` (line 34): `http://localhost:5174` → `http://localhost:5000`.
- Backend webServer (lines 46–54): `port: 3001` → `5001`; env `PORT: "3001"` → `"5001"`.
- Vite webServer (lines 55–63): `port: 5174` → `5000`; env `API_PORT: "3001"` → `"5001"`, `VITE_PORT: "5174"` → `"5000"`.

## B. E2E spec files — CRITICAL, missed by the parent issue's prescription

These specs hardcode the API URL against port **3001**. After A3 moves the backend to 5001, every direct-API call breaks unless these are updated. (The browser-driven tests go through the Vite proxy and are unaffected, but all `request.get/post(...)` API-direct calls are.)

### B1. Files that use a single `BASE` constant (1-line edit each):
- `e2e/phase3-validation.spec.ts:20` — `const BASE = "http://localhost:3001"` → `"http://localhost:5001"`
- `e2e/phase4-validation.spec.ts:29` — same
- `e2e/dashboard-roots-validation.spec.ts:20` — same
- `e2e/url-filters-validation.spec.ts:24` — same

### B2. Files with inline `http://localhost:3001` URLs (no BASE const):
- `e2e/phase1-validation.spec.ts` — 3 occurrences (all `/api/health`, lines 15/20/32)
- `e2e/phase2-validation.spec.ts` — **60 occurrences** across the file (all `http://localhost:3001/...`)

  Recommended approach for phase1 & phase2: introduce a `const BASE = "http://localhost:5001"` constant (matching phase3/phase4 convention) and replace inline URLs with `${BASE}/...` template strings. This both fixes the port and prevents future port-wide renames from requiring 60 edits. Alternatively a mechanical find/replace of `http://localhost:3001` → `http://localhost:5001` is acceptable but leaves the inline-URL footgun in place. Either way, all 63 occurrences must change.

**Note for the implementer:** the `request` fixture used in these specs is Playwright's independent APIRequestContext — it does NOT inherit `baseURL` from the `use` config (that only applies to the browser `page`). So the URLs must be changed in the specs themselves; raising `baseURL` alone is insufficient.

## C. No changes needed (verified)

- `packages/webapp/frontend/src/api/client.ts` — uses relative `"/api"` and relies on the Vite proxy. No port hardcoding. ✓
- All `frontend/src/hooks/*` — call the client, not fetch directly. ✓
- `packages/webapp/package.json` scripts — no port references (`dev:server`, `dev:frontend`, `dev`, `build`, `test:e2e`). ✓
- `packages/webapp/frontend/package.json` — no port references. ✓
- `e2e/setup.ts` / `e2e/global-setup.ts` — no port references. ✓
- The 3000s appearing in `frontend/src/components/layout/Header.tsx` (lines 32, 47) are `setTimeout(..., 3000)` durations (ms), NOT ports. Leave unchanged.

## D. Docs & expertise files (update for guidance accuracy — outside webapp code, but in scope per issue)

- `.agentic/specs/webapp-spec.md`:
  - Line 724: `const port = process.env.PORT || 3000;` → `3001`
  - Line 762: env table row `| PORT | 3000 | Server port |` → `3001`
  - Lines 768–775 (§4.6 Dev server setup): currently says "Vite dev server runs on port 5173 ... proxies to Hono on port 3000". Rewrite to: vite on 3000, proxies `/api` to Hono on 3001. Update the embedded vite.config.ts snippet accordingly.
- `.agentic/specs/webapp-roadmap.md` line 35: "Configure Vite proxy for `/api` -> `http://localhost:3000`" → `3001`.
- `.agentic/expertise/webapp-validator/webapp-server-ports.expertise.md` — referenced by the parent issue; the implementer should verify and update any documented port values there (I could not read it — outside webapp-developer access).

## E. Implementation & validation notes for the next agent

1. Order matters: do A1→A2→A3 together, then B (specs must match A3's new API port).
2. Dev sanity check after A1/A2: run `bun run dev:server` and `bun run dev:frontend` separately and confirm server logs `http://localhost:3001` and vite logs `http://localhost:3000`.
3. E2E regression: run the full suite `cd packages/webapp && npx playwright test` (use `npx`, NOT `bunx` — see webapp-e2e-validation expertise). Expect all 152 to pass once B is done.
4. Suggested follow-up (out of scope here): extract the e2e API base URL into a single shared constant (e.g. in `e2e/setup.ts`) so phase1/phase2 stop hardcoding it. I'll file this as a separate idea issue.

## Summary
- 3 config files to edit (A1–A3).
- 6 e2e spec files to edit (B1: 4 one-liners; B2: 63 inline URLs across phase1+phase2).
- Docs/specs/expertise to refresh (D).
- No frontend client or package.json changes needed.

Completed the planning audit. Posted the concrete change list in the previous comment (comment mqh2nfnt2o). Key finding: the parent issue's prescription missed the 6 e2e spec files that hardcode the API port (phase1 + phase2 alone have 63 inline `http://localhost:3001` URLs that would all break when the backend moves to 5001). Also filed a follow-up idea (mqh2nk7khi) to extract a shared e2e base-URL constant.

No code changes were made — this was a planning-only task. Reassigning to project-manager for review and to unblock the implementation child (mqh2hwulrt).

Reviewed the planning audit (comment mqh2nfnt2o). Spot-checked against source: server/index.ts:29 (PORT "3000"), vite.config.ts:6-7 (apiPort "3000", vitePort undefined fallback), playwright.config.ts (3001/5174/baseURL 5174) — all match exactly. The audit correctly extends beyond the parent's prescription to include the 6 e2e spec files with hardcoded API URLs (63 occurrences in phase1+phase2), which would have broken on the port move. Plan is approved. Marking done to unblock implementation (mqh2hwulrt).
